low_tide.title: The Harbor at Low Tide
low_tide.text: A town without a place on any chart. Its lamps are lit. Someone expected you.

variants.spooky: A town has come out of the sea, and every lamp is waiting for a visitor.
variants.grim: A town without a place on any chart. Its lamps are lit. Someone expected you.
variants.gore_dread: The sea has peeled back its skin. Beneath it: a town, still breathing through its lamps.

bellhouse.title: The Bellhouse Ledger
bellhouse.text: The Council recorded every stolen cargo. The missing column was people.

variants.spooky: These records tell a sad truth. Help the town remember the people it forgot.
variants.grim: The Council recorded every stolen cargo. The missing column was people.
variants.gore_dread: The Council recorded every stolen cargo. The missing column was people.

council.title: Council Beneath the Light
council.text: An empty chair is still a chair. Sit carefully. Decide what this light is for.

variants.spooky: The chairs are empty. The decision is yours: where should the light lead?
variants.grim: An empty chair is still a chair. Sit carefully. Decide what this light is for.
variants.gore_dread: An empty chair is still a chair. Sit carefully. Decide what this light is for.

high_water.title: The Terror Turn
high_water.text: There goes the road. The sea has remembered where it left this town.

variants.spooky: The tide is back. Stay together; a new route waits through the channel.
variants.grim: There goes the road. The sea has remembered where it left this town.
variants.gore_dread: The streets fill like opened lungs. The Harbor is drawing its next breath.

flood.title: High Water
flood.text: Rope, oil, names. Keep what you can carry. Decide who you can bring.

variants.spooky: Keep your ropes close and your friends closer. There is still time to help.
variants.grim: Rope, oil, names. Keep what you can carry. Decide who you can bring.
variants.gore_dread: Cold fingers rise through the floorboards. Some are asking for help. Some remember your name.

last_light.title: Last Light
last_light.text: A lighthouse promises a destination. Before you turn the lens, choose who should find it.

variants.spooky: One last light. Make it a promise you can keep.
variants.grim: A lighthouse promises a destination. Before you turn the lens, choose who should find it.
variants.gore_dread: A lighthouse promises a destination. Before you turn the lens, choose who should find it.

ending.title: The Last Bell
ending.text: No more rehearsals. Ring it. Let the Harbor hear what you decided.

variants.spooky: No more rehearsals. Ring it. Let the Harbor hear what you decided.
variants.grim: No more rehearsals. Ring it. Let the Harbor hear what you decided.
variants.gore_dread: No more rehearsals. Ring it. Let the Harbor hear what you decided.

epilogue.title: What Came Home
epilogue.text: The shore will ask what happened here. You may find yourselves giving different answers.

variants.spooky: The shore will ask what happened here. You may find yourselves giving different answers.
variants.grim: The shore will ask what happened here. You may find yourselves giving different answers.
variants.gore_dread: The shore will ask what happened here. You may find yourselves giving different answers.

complete.title: Until the Next Low Tide
complete.text: That is where your account ends. The sea, of course, keeps its own.

variants.spooky: That is where your account ends. The sea, of course, keeps its own.
variants.grim: That is where your account ends. The sea, of course, keeps its own.
variants.gore_dread: That is where your account ends. The sea, of course, keeps its own.

lantern_surveyor.title: Lantern Surveyor
lantern_surveyor.text: You map the passages nobody believes are still there. A steady lamp makes a route out of a rumor.

bellhouse_archivist.title: Bellhouse Archivist
bellhouse_archivist.text: You know the difference between an absent name and an erased one. The ledger owes you both.

lifeboat_keeper.title: Lifeboat Keeper
lifeboat_keeper.text: You count places, not promises. A rope in your hands has always meant someone gets another chance.

fog_listener.title: Fog Listener
fog_listener.text: The fog carries voices before it carries shapes. You have learned when to listen, and when to move.

wreckers_heir.title: Wrecker’s Heir
wreckers_heir.text: Your inheritance washed ashore in pieces. You can turn wreckage into shelter, if you can bear what it belonged to.

tide_chapel_warden.title: Tide Chapel Warden
tide_chapel_warden.text: You keep a place for those who cannot cross the water. Even a ghost should have somewhere to stand.

search_manifest.text: A relief ship. Food. Medicine. Passengers. The wreck was deliberate.

search_wreck.text: A survivor wrote between the cargo lines. Small handwriting can carry a great accusation.

salvage_oil.text: The lantern takes the oil. The patrol takes an interest.

secure_boat.text: An extra knot. Two more places. Sometimes hope is this practical.

shelter.text: For a moment, even the bell has nothing to add.

aid_resident.text: The rope tightens. Someone on the other end remembers being alive.

follow_names.text: Give a stolen name its place again, and listen to what changes.

follow_light.text: The lens is cracked. Its invitation is perfectly clear.

follow_missing.text: One blank line. One open passage. Absence can be a kind of mercy.

search_archive.text: The pages survived. Your breath may not last as long.

salt_ward.text: Salt draws a boundary the water understands.

harbor_bargain.text: An offer can sound like rescue. Read it twice.

refuse_bargain.text: You keep your own name. The Harbor does not thank you for it.

restless_warn.text: A voice from beneath the water. Still yours. Still useful.

rescue.text: Not every name in the ledger has to stay there.

defeat.text: The tide has taken your breath. It has not taken your turn.

director.text: The Harbor changes its attention. It has learned which streets you favor.
